hazards.source_text: night yellow warnings of precipitation of 20 mm were issued in an hour and 60 mm in twelve hours throughout Castellón.

hazards.source_text: to 40 mm in an hour in Northern Litoral (orange), to 30 mm in an hour in Northern Interior and to 80 mm in twelve hours in Northern Interior, Northern Litoral and Southern Litoral of Castellón.

hazards.source_text: The passage of a supercell (SP28-II), between 21:00 and 23:00 hours, left very strong precipitation in the area of El Ejido (district of Poniente and Almería Capital) accompanied by hail of more than 5 cm and a tornado.

evidence.quote: The passage of a supercell (SP28-II), between 21:00 and 23:00 hours, left very strong precipitation in the area of El Ejido (district of Poniente and Almería Capital) accompanied by hail of more than 5 cm and a tornado.

hazards.source_text: At the station of El Ejido it was recorded up to 33.8 mm in an hour, as well as at some station of the Hydrographic Confederation of the South located in the natural site of Punta del Sabinar where the 40 mm were slightly exceeded in an hour.

hazards.source_text: On the other hand, at night a Mesoescalar Convective System (EP28-III) was formed in the Sea of Alborán that was moving towards Malaga and that continued to affect Tuesday 29 with an extraordinary electrical activity to the provinces of Malaga and Seville, causing significant damage.

hazards.source_text: During this day the largest accumulated of the whole week occurred in the province of Valencia, although there were other hot spots with great intensity located in the provinces of Murcia, Albacete, Cuenca, Almería and Malaga.
